name: NVIDIA HGX H100 and HGX H200 datasheet
notes: Direct PDF fetch (doc 3361709, Jul 24). Gives 4-GPU and 8-GPU HGX H100/H200 platform specs. Notably publishes NO rack power or TDP figure for HGX baseboards - the Hopper HGX platforms are sold without a power envelope, while every Blackwell platform datasheet publishes Max TDP per GPU. That asymmetry is itself the finding.
